Run With Will Participation Terms

These draft Participation Terms are structurally prepared for attorney review and final client approval before any public participation release or waiver is relied upon.

Voluntary Participation

Participation in any Run With Will activity is voluntary. Final participant acknowledgement language is [ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED].

Nature of the Activity

Run With Will activities may involve running, walking, gathering near public roads, meeting at changing locations, and participating near event travel or logistics.

Inherent Risks

Running events and public-route activities involve inherent risks, including injury, illness, collision, traffic exposure, uneven surfaces, dehydration, weather exposure, and other hazards. Final risk language is [ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED].

Health and Fitness Responsibility

Participants are responsible for determining whether they are healthy, trained, and fit enough to participate. Participants should consult a medical professional when appropriate.

Weather, Roads and Environmental Conditions

Conditions may include heat, cold, rain, wind, darkness, traffic, crowds, construction, and route changes. Participants are responsible for using caution and judgment.

Following Event / Organizer Instructions

Participants must follow instructions from event organizers, local officials, venue staff, law enforcement, and other authorized personnel.

Route and Schedule Changes

Routes, meeting points, times, and participation windows may change or be canceled at any time due to safety, weather, travel, operational, or other considerations.

Emergency Situations

Participants should call emergency services when urgent help is needed and follow directions from local authorities and medical personnel.

Participant Conduct

Participants must act responsibly, respect other participants and the public, obey laws, avoid unsafe behavior, and avoid interfering with event operations.

Minors / Age Requirements

Minor participation, guardian consent, and age requirements have not been finalized. [LEGAL / CLIENT INPUT REQUIRED].

Photography, Video and Media

Event areas may be photographed or recorded for media, social, promotional, or documentary purposes. Final media release language is [ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED].

Personal Belongings

Participants are responsible for their own personal belongings. Final property-loss language is [ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED].

Assumption of Risk

[ATTORNEY-APPROVED ASSUMPTION OF RISK LANGUAGE REQUIRED]

Governing Law
